issues.message: Missing unique constraint on (note_id, user_id) to enforce the requirement that 'one user can rate each note only once'. This is critical for data integrity.
Missing unique constraint on (group_id, user_id) to prevent duplicate group memberships. This could lead to data inconsistencies.
No bookmarks/saved_notes table exists, but the design shows a 'Saved' tab in the user profile (F2 acceptance criteria mentions download but not explicit save/bookmark feature).
NFRs are completely missing. No specifications for performance (response times, concurrent users), security standards (encryption, authentication details), scalability targets, or availability SLAs.
Missing check constraint on rating field to enforce 1-5 range validation. Currently only documented in notes, not enforced at database level.
Missing avatar_url field, but design extensively shows user avatars throughout the application (profile header, message bubbles, author info, etc.).
Missing file_size and file_type fields for proper file management and validation. Only file_url is stored.
Design shows notification bell icon in header, but no notification feature is defined in requirements (F1-F5).
Missing updated_at timestamp fields for audit trails and tracking record modifications. Only created_at exists.
Platform Administrator role is defined in requirements but no admin-specific features or screens are documented in requirements or design.
Design shows attachment button in message input, but no attachment_url or attachment_type fields exist in group_messages table.

Acceptance criteria states 'Given a downloaded note, When a student submits a rating' - this implies rating is only possible after download, but this business rule is not reflected in database constraints.

required_fixes: Add unique constraint on note_ratings(note_id, user_id) to enforce one rating per user per note
Add unique constraint on group_members(group_id, user_id) to prevent duplicate memberships
Create bookmarks/saved_notes table with columns: id (UUID PK), user_id (FK to users), note_id (FK to notes), saved_at (timestamp), and unique constraint on (user_id, note_id)

Add comprehensive Non-Functional Requirements section covering: performance metrics (response time <2s, support 10k concurrent users), security standards (JWT expiration, password complexity, HTTPS), scalability (horizontal scaling capability), availability (99.9% uptime), and data retention policies
Add check constraint on note_ratings.rating field: CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
Add avatar_url VARCHAR(500) nullable field to users table for profile pictures
Add file_size BIGINT and file_type VARCHAR(50) fields to notes table
Add updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP to all tables for audit trails
Either add notifications feature to requirements or remove notification bell from design, or document as future enhancement
Add attachment_url TEXT and attachment_type VARCHAR(50) nullable fields to group_messages table to support file attachments shown in design
recommendations: Consider adding soft delete functionality with is_deleted boolean and deleted_at timestamp fields to all tables instead of hard deletes, enabling data recovery and audit compliance
Add email_verification_token and token_expiry fields to users table to support the email verification flow mentioned in F1 acceptance criteria
Create a subjects reference table to standardize subject categories across notes and study_groups, ensuring data consistency and enabling better filtering
Add rate limiting and API throttling specifications to NFRs to prevent abuse of upload and messaging features
Consider adding a group_join_requests table to handle the 'approval' process mentioned in F3 acceptance criteria ('added to group upon approval')
Add indexes on frequently queried fields like note_ratings.rating for sorting by rating, and group_messages.created_at for chronological message retrieval
Document data retention and GDPR compliance requirements, especially for user data deletion and right to be forgotten
Add version control or edit history for notes to track changes and maintain academic integrity
Consider adding a reports/moderation table to handle inappropriate content flagging mentioned implicitly by Platform Administrator role
Specify backup and disaster recovery procedures in NFRs, including RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) targets
